description: A badge (DESIGN.md, Badge): a Badge.count pill ("99+" above 99) or a Badge.dot, meant to be pinned on a host's corner through its `badge:` slot (see pinBadge, used by IconButton and Avatar). Always decorative: its meaning belongs to the host's accessible name, not to the badge itself.

params.name: count
params.description: Shown as text, "99+" above 99; null for a dot.
